head: Habit 1: Double cleanse
r: Wash twice. Sweat off first, then clean skin

label: HABIT 2
head: Exfoliate your body
sub: Scrub or mitt. Dead skin is where the smell sits.

items.head: Witch hazel after the shower
items.sub: Cotton pad on chest and back for leftover oil.

items.head: Rotate your deodorant
items.sub: Switch formulas every 1 to 2 months when it stops working.

items.head: Lotion on damp skin
items.sub: Within 3 minutes of drying off. Locks moisture in.

items.head: Lip balm before bed
items.sub: No dry, cracked lips in the morning.

label: HABIT 7
head: Wear one signature scent
sub: Same one every day. People start linking it to you.

text: Women aren't cleaner by nature. They just follow a *routine.*
